svg.title: Saved traffic must exceed added work
svg.desc: At 300 GB/second effective bandwidth, 6 GB weights need 20 ms and 1.55 GB need 5.167 ms. Adding 2 ms work gives 7.167 ms. If baseline effective traffic falls to 0.6 GB through reuse, its model time is 2 ms. A 2 ms added overhead can then erase a gain.

g.text: B16 = 6.00 GB; B4 = 1.55 GB; bandwidth = 300 GB/s
Real traffic, reuse and kernels can invalidate both estimates.
